1.5 Choose the problem before choosing the repair

What you observe First useful question Recipe
A missing-photo badge after moving a drive Does the original still exist, and is it the same source? Repair locations
Sync progress appears stuck Which exact stage is making, receiving, or completing work? Separate Sync stages
A selected upload has a proxy-missing error Are the expected historical proxy and current source the same admitted identity? Recover a proxy upload
Dates gain .000 and metadata work returns Is the native assignment provably redundant, and is queue removal durable? Date requeue
Each metadata save or relocation takes seconds Is native SQL scanning a large table despite an existing index? Diagnose SQL affinity
CPU remains high with tiny Sync changes Is a full mapping table repeatedly queried, copied, or transported? Reduce map work
Downloads repeat but do not become catalog items Does the destination resolver need a catalog folder on a reader? Repair folder admission
A preview exists but editing is blocked Are image data and the exact requested settings both available? Recover settings
An import succeeded but its verifier failed Did the native action finish before the diagnostic error? Recover verification
Several files look like duplicates Which identity has actually been proved? Classify identity
A converter preview or shared cache seems reusable Do current native identities and actual adoption agree? Converter reuse, Cloud clones
A metadata badge conflicts with expected edits Which catalog, sidecar or embedded fields differ? Metadata divergence
You want to delete originals that a backup should already hold Is every source file accounted for by content, and can it be restored byte for byte? Prove a backup
A photo will not render or edit, though its thumbnail looks fine Is its raw data truncated, and does an intact conversion of the same exposure exist? Replace a damaged original
The originals are offline and you want to cull in another application Can previews carry camera metadata, and where do the ratings go? Browse offline
